Application Component                                              FI-CA

Direction                                                                 inbound

Mode                                                                     synchronous

Idempotency                                                           no

Change/Update Behavior                                           not applicable

P2P Communication Enabled                                      true

Business Context and Use

The inbound operation Find Contract Account Receivables Payables Register Item by ID returns the items of a contract
account according to specified selection criteria.

Related Operations

The operations Find Contract Account Split Item Group by Business Partner ID and Find Contract Account Split Item Group by
Elements can be used to return the items of a contract account based on other selection criteria.

You can use the operation Create Payment Directive to assign Splitltems to a PaymentDirective and thus release them for

collection by the corresponding payment run. The released Splitltems are grouped together if they are set to be paid by the same
payment method.

The current operation returns items posted in FI-CA. To find items posted in FI-AR, you can use the operation Find Trade
Receivables Payables Account Split Item Group by Customer ID which belongs to the process component Due Item Processing.

The corresponding message structures are very similar to the message structures used in the current operation.

Features

The selection of contract accounts can be based on various criteria, including

e external contract account ID
e business partner IDs

¢ company codes to be read

e item clearing status

e arange of posting dates

e earliest clearing date and latest due date (which an associated document must have in order to be included in the
selection).
